summary.name: Libervia Web
summary.one_liner: Libervia is a web frontend for XMPP messaging from Salut à Toi, licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python.
use_cases: run a self-hosted xmpp web client
access xmpp chat from a browser
host a web frontend for xmpp messaging
summary.what_it_does: The page itself is only an Anubis bot-check interstitial, so no features of Libervia are described here. Per the listing, Libervia is a web frontend from Salut à Toi and is listed in awesome-selfhosted under XMPP web clients. It is licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Python. The page explains that Anubis uses a Hashcash-style proof-of-work challenge to slow down scrapers and requires modern JavaScript, so privacy plugins such as JShelter must be disabled for the domain.
notable: Web frontend for XMPP, from Salut à Toi
Page is gated by Anubis proof-of-work bot check requiring JavaScript
caveats: Page content is only a bot-check screen; Libervia features could not be verified from this page
Requires modern JavaScript; JShelter or similar plugins must be disabled for this domain to load the page
